# Placement witness changes history depth after the first write

## Context

The existing Dock NL evidence lane `#17844` now reaches `DockPlacementNL.spec.mjs`’s history setup on Engine `887835e83a1e53a257eb83b9c9dc9ea6fb6e4166`. The focused journey fails because its late `setHistoryDepth({groupId, depth: 6})` returns false.

An unchanged run reproduced the refusal. A diagnostic-only rerun retained the oracle and captured:

| Stage | Depth | History ready | Rows / cursor | Cause |
|---|---:|---|---|---|
| Before popup setup | 50 | false | none | none |
| After initial popup positioning | 50 | true | 1 / 0 | native-popup-move |
| Late setter result | 50 | true | 1 / 0 | false, state unchanged |

A live Neural Link control on a fresh owned Group returned true for the same depth before history loaded. This is an attributed witness-setup defect, not a request to relax the engine guard.

## The Problem

The spec treats its initial popup positioning as free setup, but that native movement already records a legitimate history row. It then changes policy after the Group locked it and assumes the later movement, undo/redo and subsequent movement start from an empty history.

Removing the refusal assertion alone would leave the absolute row/cursor expectations stale and weaken the journey.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/manager/Transaction.mjs#setHistoryDepth` fixes policy before history loads and refuses late changes.
- `examples/dashboard/crossWindow/DemoBWorkspace.mjs#adoptTopologyGroup` chooses the host’s depth before placement participation.
- `src/dashboard/dock/window/Placement.mjs` records native popup movement as an appended transaction; main-frame rebasing preserves history.
- `test/playwright/e2e/dashboard/DockPlacementNL.spec.mjs` owns this failing setup and the complete placement/undo/redo/reload witness.

Design authority: `Transaction#setHistoryDepth` JSDoc states that the bound is fixed at the first history load. Product behavior remains unchanged.

## The Fix

Configure the test Group before its first placement history write. Settle and retain the initial positioning’s history baseline. Assert subsequent movement and undo/redo against that baseline, including the correct transaction row’s before-hints and cause. Keep the full rebasing, correlated native-effect, persistence and popup-generation legs.

Prescription checked: the existing E2E owns the setup order and baseline; no new helper module or production API is needed.

## Contract Ledger

N/A — existing witness correction only. No public config, wire or runtime API changes.

Decision Record impact: aligned-with ADR 0029; no authority mutation.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Depth is configured successfully before the Group history loads.
- [ ] Initial popup positioning’s recorded history is explicitly settled and used as the baseline, rather than discarded.
- [ ] The tested movement adds exactly one row with the expected cause and before-hints.
- [ ] Main-frame rebasing preserves the complete history; undo/redo preserve row count and move the cursor relative to the baseline, with correlated native effects.
- [ ] A later free movement appends once; durable placement hints and popup reload/generation replacement remain verified.
- [ ] The full existing journey passes with the external Brain runtime wired; the formerly failing source remains the red control.
- [ ] The resulting receipt is linked back to `#17844`, without claiming a full-battery or headed/native acceptance pass.

## Out of Scope

Changing history policy/refusal semantics, clearing history to hide setup, Demo B perspective mount-count repair, or new journey/app surfaces.

## Avoided Traps

No guard relaxation; no swallowed setter refusal; no fixed sleeps as settledness; no assertion deletion in place of a semantic baseline.
